blogPosts.title: Bathroom Vanity Trends 2026: A Guide for Horsham Homeowners
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover 2026 bathroom vanity trends for Horsham homeowners. From floating designs to bold colours and smart storage, find the perfect vanity for your home.
body: The bathroom vanity is one of the most used and most visible elements of any Horsham home, and choosing the right one can make a huge difference to both the look and functionality of your bathroom. In 2026, Horsham homeowners are increasingly looking beyond standard flat-pack vanities and turning to custom-designed solutions that fit their space perfectly and reflect their personal style. West Vic Cabinetry has been designing and building custom bathroom vanities for Horsham and Wimmera homes, and we are seeing some exciting trends emerging this year. From floating wall-hung designs to bold colour choices and clever storage innovations, here is what Horsham homeowners need to know about bathroom vanity trends in 2026.

Wall-hung or floating vanities continue to dominate bathroom design in Horsham and across Australia in 2026, and for good reason. By mounting the vanity to the wall and keeping the floor underneath clear, these designs create a sense of space that is particularly valuable in Horsham's older homes, which often have smaller bathrooms. The exposed floor beneath a floating vanity makes the room feel larger and more open, while also making cleaning significantly easier — no more trying to mop around cabinet legs. At West Vic Cabinetry, we custom-build floating vanities to your exact specifications, ensuring the wall structure can properly support the unit. We also incorporate soft-close drawers and integrated LED lighting options that enhance both the functionality and the visual appeal of your Horsham bathroom.

Colour is playing a much bigger role in bathroom vanity design in 2026, and Horsham homeowners are embracing bolder choices. While classic white and neutral tones remain popular, we are seeing a growing demand for vanities in deep greens, navy blues, warm terracotta, and even matte black finishes. These colours add personality and warmth to what can sometimes feel like the most clinical room in the house. In the Wimmera, where natural landscapes feature earthy reds, golden wheat fields, and big blue skies, it is no surprise that Horsham homeowners are drawn to vanity colours that echo the natural beauty of their surroundings. At West Vic Cabinetry, we offer a wide range of colour and finish options for custom vanities, from classic two-pack painted finishes to timber-look laminates that bring natural warmth to your Horsham bathroom.

Smart storage is a top priority for Horsham homeowners choosing a new bathroom vanity in 2026, and custom cabinetry offers solutions that flat-pack vanities simply cannot match. Drawers with internal dividers for toiletries, built-in organisers for cosmetics and grooming tools, hidden power points for electric toothbrushes and shavers, and pull-out bins for waste are just some of the clever storage features we are incorporating into our custom vanities at West Vic Cabinetry. For Horsham families sharing a bathroom, we often design double-basin vanities with separate drawer banks for each person, reducing morning chaos and keeping the space tidy. We also recommend integrated towel storage, either open shelving or heated towel rail niches built into the vanity design.

The materials you choose for your bathroom vanity need to handle Horsham's unique climate conditions, where summer temperatures can exceed 40 degrees and winter mornings regularly drop below freezing. Moisture resistance is critical in bathroom cabinetry, and at West Vic Cabinetry, we use high-quality Australian-made moisture-resistant board products that are specifically engineered for wet areas. Our vanity carcasses are sealed on all exposed edges to prevent moisture ingress, and we use marine-grade or moisture-resistant laminates for the exterior surfaces. Benchtop options include durable laminate in stone or timber looks, as well as solid surface materials that resist staining and water damage.

If you are planning a bathroom renovation in Horsham and want a vanity that is designed specifically for your space, the team at West Vic Cabinetry is ready to help. We will visit your Horsham home to measure your bathroom, discuss your design ideas and storage needs, and provide a detailed, no-obligation quote. Our process takes you from your initial idea through design, approval, production, and professional installation, with our team handling every step. We are dedicated to getting every detail right, from the angle of your drawer runners to the alignment of your basin cutout. Contact us on 0493 437 290 or visit our workshop at 49 Hamilton Rd, Horsham to start designing your perfect bathroom vanity today.
